blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Three hundred eleven assorted weapons were recovered and 27 individuals were arrested in the campaign against unlicensed firearms in the Soccsksargen region (Region 12) in October, police said Monday. “The intensified operations aim to prevent loose firearms from falling into the hands of criminal elements across the region,” Brig. Gen. Alan Manibog, Police Regional Office-12 (PRO-12), director, said. He said the operations resulted in the recovery, confiscation, surrender, deposit, abandonment, or forfeiture of 311 firearms, one explosive device, and 803 rounds of ammunition. The 311 firearms recovered consisted of 299 small arms and 12 light weapons. Manibog said. […]... Keep on reading: Month-long drive vs. loose firearms nets 311 weapons in Soccsksargen
